data.long_meaning: Sadham is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sadhana', which means 'Righteous Practice'. It is a name that signifies a person who is just, honest and wise. The name Sadham is deeply rooted in the Hindu tradition and is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune to the bearer. The name Sadham carries the meaning “Righteous, Just, Honest” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sadham usually hope their child will grow to embody righteous, just, honest and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Sadham is deeply spiritual in meaning as it underscores the importance of self-discipline, self-control, and dedication towards a higher purpose.
